title: Plants vs. Zombies: Game of the Year

engine.name: PopCap SexyAppFramework
engine.evidence: Small native executable (5.3 MB) with BASS audio (bass.dll), properties/default.xml, properties/Layout.xml UI definitions and partner.xml; no engine payload file of its own.
engine.notes: Simple, self-contained 2D engine. Everything the game needs ships in the installation.

dependencies.notes: Reached from an optional menu action; no campaign or save path uses it. Offline behaviour is expected to be a failed request, to be confirmed by measurement.

staticAnalysis.method: PE header/import parse plus ASCII string scan
staticAnalysis.limits: Save location is not yet established on this machine because the game has never been launched here. The profile will record it once measured rather than guessing.

notes: Best first offline-acceptance candidate: no mandatory service, no launcher layer, a single executable.
